question: Is the 125-test Part failure really an environment limitation, and can it be cleared?

root_cause.mechanism: Test binaries resolve data through App::Application::getHomePath(), which for a build-tree binary is the build root. cmake --build creates neither directory the tests expect there.

missing_paths.symptom: brep fixtures load as empty shapes, volume 0

root_cause.red_herring: RESOURCEDIR is set to 'share' during configuration and overrides any value passed on the command line, so the lookup is always <AppHomePath>/share/...

verification: Each link was removed individually and the corresponding failures returned, then restored and the suite went green again.
corrections_to_the_record: Rounds 002-005 recorded '125 environment failures' as a fact about the Part suite. The true baseline is 331 of 331 passing.
unblocks: P0-E change challenge at document level

app_suite_unchanged.note: the three pre-existing App failures recorded in round 001 are unaffected and remain unexplained
